GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-07-03T18:14:38Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Is it possible to change zkpath for a ReplicatedMergeTree table?
Description: At first I have created a distributed table (let us name it **table_A**). And then I decided to move the data to a ReplicatedMergeTable. I did it as below:

`create table table_B as table_A engine=ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/01/{database}/{table}', '{replica}');`
`insert into table_B select * from table_A;`

So far so good. After that, I drop the distributed table and rename the new one to the old name.

`drop table table_A;`
`rename table table_B to table_A;`

Then I tried to insert some data into table_A, it threw an error:

`Table is in readonly mode (zookeeper path: /clickhouse/tables/01/default/table_B)`

I have tried to find some command to fix the zookeeper path for this table as alter table and etc. but nothing found.

Is it a solution to make it out?
